paragraphs.text: Demigod is a creature type for beings with partial or lesser divine status, such as a minor deity , the offspring of a god and a mortal, or a mortal raised to divine rank.
Demigods appear across all colors .

Demigod was introduced as a creature type for Theros in Theros Beyond Death . Before that, a group of creatures that were also called demigods were featured in Shadowmoor and Eventide , but were typed as Spirit Avatars .
Commander Masters would bring back the type on Anikthea, Hand of Erabos . Marvel Super Heroes would introduce 2 new demigod creatures.
The first demigods were printed in a cycle in Theros Beyond Death .
There are 6 known demigods on Theros, all of whom originated as humans before gaining the favor or anger of the gods. They are Anax , Anikthea , Callaphe , Daxos , Renata , and Tymaret .
Razia , the parun of the Boros Legion , was considered to be a demi-god. However, she was just a powerful archangel .
The demigods of Shadowmoor were powerful spirit avatars . Tales of each Demigod made up the epic poem The Seer's Parables .

The Seer's Parables was an epic poem written on the plane Shadowmoor. The plot details a Kithkin resident of Shadowmoor's visit to a Kithkin seer. The Kithkin asks the seer how the world will end, to which the seer replies, "You are not ready for my answer. Perhaps there are other things you wish to know?" .

The Kithkin proceeds to ask the seer several questions about her existence and about life on Shadowmoor. The seer answers each question. The Kithkin's questions and the seer's answer divide the poem into several sections, in each of which a legend of one demigod is told.
The sections of The Seer's Parables and their respective Demigod are as follows:
Evolution : Overbeing of Myth
Destruction : Deus of Calamity
Bloodthirst : Demigod of Revenge
Hope : Oversoul of Dusk
Warfare : Nobilis of War
Discord : Dominus of Fealty
Claw : Deity of Scars
Dominion : Godhead of Awe
Decay : Ghastlord of Fugue
Omens : Divinity of Pride

In the section Omens , the Kithkin seer sheds her skin to reveal that she is not a Kithkin at all, and emerges as one of the Demigods, the Divinity of Pride, and finally answers the Kithkin's original question, driving the Kithkin insane.

The Demigods are represented as cards in the Shadowmoor block . Each is a rare creature with the creature type Spirit Avatar. Each Demigod in Shadowmoor has a mana cost of {A/B}{A/B}{A/B}{A/B}{A/B} where A and B are allied colors. Each Demigod in Eventide has a cost of {C/D}{C/D}{C/D}{C/D}{C/D}, where C and D are enemy colors. Each Demigod has an Aura card associated with them in their respective colors.
Eron is revered as a demigod by the goblins .
